title: Investigation: Polymarket is paying creators to make deceptive videos about winning bets, targeting users in the US, where its primary crypto platform is banned (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Investigation: Polymarket is paying creators to make deceptive videos about winning bets, targeting users in the US, where its primary crypto platform is banned — The prediction market has flooded social media with deceptive videos by paid creators, according to a Wall Street Journal investigation
